name: Find a pig
flow: scan or use a sample tag

notes.purpose: A drawer that looks a sample pig or pen up by ear tag or pen code.

elements.name: Search field
elements.shows: One field for a tag or a pen code
elements.rule: Required, up to 30 characters. Matches a whole ear tag or a whole pen code (case-insensitive); a part of a tag finds nothing.
elements.logic: The study searches the sample task records only (every pig of every task, Units 1-13); it does not read the real pig list.

issues: Ear notch search (named in the Pigs section) is not offered.

notes.purpose: A drawer for reading an ear tag with the camera or tag reader.

elements.name: Scanner and tag field
elements.shows: Camera frame, a tag field and "Use a sample tag"
elements.rule: Camera and tag-reader hardware are not connected (the PREVIEW badge of the app says so; the sheet carries no note); the sample tag button runs the same lookup with a known tag (000302).

edge: Camera denied, tag unreadable and torn-tag cases are not drawn.

notes.purpose: The matching pigs, each opening the work it belongs to.

elements.name: Result row

states.when: The tag or pen code matches
states.shows: Up to 12 rows (a pen code can match several pigs in many tasks)
"No pig or pen matches." and Search again

elements.logic: A row opens the task that holds the pig, in its unit: Farrowing and Piglet processing open their prototypes; any other task opens the task stand-in. It does not open the pig's record.

issues: A result opens the task, not the pig (see Pig profile).
The no-match state needs typed text and is not reachable in the atlas.
